about: The one-line short description on each arcade card's Poster reveal (Shombith, 2026-11-23: 'the description is too big there should be a short description'). Written into SO_Game.ShortDescription by author_card_short_lines.py (--check). Keep each under 48 characters; an empty line shows nothing.

lines.ArcadeGameSkimRace: Skim trails for speed. First to the crystal.
lines.ArcadeGameJoust: Ram rivals for jousts. Most jousts wins.
lines.ArcadeGameMaelstrom: A gauntlet of games, one crown.
lines.ArcadeGameCleave: Four arenas, one blade. Cut the most.
lines.ArcadeGameWildlifeLiberation: Break the cages, hunt the wildlife.
lines.ArcadeGameDogFight: Guns and rockets in the Boneyard.
lines.ArcadeGameBends: Cone a pilot to strip their elements.
lines.ArcadeGameScarabScramble: Bat your ball through a ring. First to ten.
lines.ArcadeGameSwitchback: A new ring course every race.
lines.ArcadeGameHijack: Grind rails, spike them, rake the burrs.
lines.ArcadeGameTollway: Graft a ring on a plant, drive balls through.
lines.ArcadeGameHeadlong: Fly straight, plough through the hedges.
lines.ArcadeGameBreakwater: Blow open fourteen walls with two rockets.
lines.ArcadeGameSkein: Ride a knot of rails through the rings.
lines.ArcadeGameBloomrush: Plant bombs, then reach a crystal.
lines.ArcadeGameRedline: Flat out. Thread each ring through its heart.
lines.ArcadeGameWreckingBall: Bowl your ball through the forest.
lines.ArcadeGameWaystation: Weave the rings down the Drop Tower.
lines.ArcadeGameDustup: Dust rivals from above. No guns.
lines.ArcadeGameTapestry: Paint the sky, shred their painting.
lines.ArcadeGameSirocco: Dust their plants, grow your own.
lines.ArcadeGameGrizzlyCharge: Nuke prisms, shove a rival, ride shockwaves.
lines.ArcadeGameGrizzlyTime: Your bombs are your speed. Beat the clock.
lines.ArcadeGameSlingshot: Steer with two holes through the rings.
lines.ArcadeGameWarpline: Dig tunnels to the next ring.
lines.ArcadeGameThresherTime: Swing on chains through the Belfry.
lines.ArcadeGameWrasseRun: Two pilots, one hull, every ring.
lines.ArcadeGameBurrowRun: Burrow from ring to ring, fastest wins.
lines.ArcadeGameScarabRally: Drift the hairpins, juke into the rings.
lines.ArcadeGameSerpentTime: Race through rings a great shape closes.
lines.ArcadeGameBrittleStarTime: Speed Mode straights, coast the corners.
lines.ArcadeGameSerpentHood: A sniper duel across a crystal heart.
lines.ArcadeGameLanternRun: Paint your path, throw your school.
lines.ArcadeGameThornline: Sling from thorn to thorn through rings.
lines.ArcadeGameDecoyRun: Herd your jacks to a decoy past the ring.
lines.ArcadeGamePerchRun: Dart ring to ring. Fewer darts, faster.
lines.ArcadeGameSlipLine: Zip down rails of your colour.
lines.ArcadeGameBreach: Burn the straights, coast the turns.
lines.ArcadeGameJackstraw: A chain brawl in floating sticks.
lines.ArcadeGameFlatline: A duel through panes your cords cut.
lines.ArcadeGameKelpwood: Lock a rival and set your school on them.
lines.ArcadeGameCorona: Arm bombs on the shells, set them off inside.
lines.ArcadeGameHarvest: Mow the stalks, whip the ball into the core.
lines.ArcadeGameShatterplane: Square up and erase whole plates.
lines.ArcadeGameGlasshouse: Plant seeds, grow the biggest garden.
lines.ArcadeGameChum: Throw your school at the shoals.
lines.ArcadeGameStarweave: Weave five trails at once. Keep them standing.
lines.ArcadeGameHaul: Swing through bales to steal their prisms.
lines.ArcadeGameHedgerow: Grow your wall along their hedge.
lines.ArcadeGameLongshot: Line up a lance, take it in one shot.
lines.ArcadeGameSpearline: Five laps. Cut the sealed rings open.
lines.ArcadeGameRiposte: A sword duel. Be the faster to land it.
lines.ArcadeGamePalisade: Swing your sword to build walls.
lines.ArcadeGameLarder: Paint a rival, every plant fires.
lines.ArcadeGameThornbush: Build nests in the thorn bush.
lines.ArcadeGameLancefall: Lay your lance along the plates.
lines.ArcadeGameShockfront: Close your holes, ripple your rivals.
lines.ArcadeGameFlitstrike: Flit through rivals. Every strike scores.
lines.ArcadeGameHoneycomb: Turn crystals into hives behind you.
lines.ArcadeGameWoodpecker: Peck the plants that are not yours.
lines.ArcadeGameStingherd: Herd your stingers into rival hulls.
lines.ArcadeGameTrawl: Net loose prisms and smash them.
lines.ArcadeGameDepthCharge: Raid the rival forest with bombs.
lines.ArcadeGameIceShelf: Hold the most mass when time runs out.
lines.ArcadeGamePodHunt: Hunt the pod with missiles and bombs.
lines.ArcadeGameRailrush: A joust on rails. Throw spikes far.
lines.ArcadeGameBullrush: Gore rivals from behind while faster.
lines.ArcadeGameWindrow: Lay rows of trail. Keep them standing.
lines.ArcadeGameLandslide: Throw prisms into prisms. Bring it down.
lines.ArcadeGameWarren: Swallow their mass, fire it back.
lines.ArcadeGameCaveIn: Swallow prisms and fire them into plates.
lines.ArcadeGameStandoff: Stick bombs on rivals behind cover.
lines.ArcadeGameCleanerRam: Charge your ram, knock their petals loose.
lines.ArcadeGameReefbuild: Loop motes to grow your reef.
lines.ArcadeGameBlastline: Loop motes to blast the overgrowth.
lines.ArcadeGameSnap: Lock a rival, fire the vortex ring.
lines.ArcadeGameDenBuilder: Lay islands, jump hills, build a den.
lines.ArcadeGameRiptide: Pull tiles into your plane and smash them.
lines.ArcadeGameMarionette: Ride a creature, attack with it.
lines.ArcadeGameGorge: Ride a creature to feast on the shoals.
